name: SEISMIC-LAB
subtitle: Geophysical Elastodynamics, Fault Rupture & Tsunami Wave Mechanics Studio

dualAuditSignOff.remediationNotes: Resolved all 5 audit items: zero-GC pre-allocated tsunami SWE buffers, physical scaling for realistic near-field PGA/PGV, dynamic displayGain for continuous sinusoidal seismogram traces, exact simulation timestamps in CSV exports, full GEOLOGY & STRATA parameter table, and acoustic phase pick needle clicks.

geophysicsEngines.elastodynamicsSolver: 2D velocity-stress staggered-grid finite-difference solver for isotropic elastic media with free-surface boundary (Rayleigh waves) and sponge absorption
geophysicsEngines.faultRuptureEngine: Double-couple tectonic fault dislocation with dip angle rotation, shear stress drop, and exponential moment magnitude scaling Mw
geophysicsEngines.seismographNetwork: 4-station surface seismometer array recording vertical (Vz) and horizontal (Vx) ground velocities with calibrated physical units (cm/s, g) and automatic P, S, and Rayleigh phase picking
geophysicsEngines.tsunamiSolver: 1D non-linear shallow water equations (SWE) with bathymetry shoaling, zero-GC buffers, and seafloor megathrust vertical uplift coupling

interactiveSystems.visualizer: 60fps HTML5 Canvas with ref-based zero-GC offscreen pipeline and pre-computed palettes (Seismic Bipolar, Magma Thermal, Turbo Velocity)
interactiveSystems.waveformDeck: Dynamic SVG multi-station rolling seismograms with adaptive gain, travel-time curves, geology strata parameters, and tsunami bathymetry plots
interactiveSystems.hypocenterGizmo: Interactive draggable star gizmo on canvas allowing real-time focal depth and epicentral relocation
interactiveSystems.seismicSonification: 100% procedural Web Audio sub-bass P-wave rumble, S-wave friction roar, earth hum, and phase pick clicks with master dynamics limiter
interactiveSystems.telemetryExport: CSV export of 4-station raw seismograms with exact simulation timestamps, CSV export of tsunami bathymetry/wave profile, and JSON earthquake simulation state
